sn20.12:1.2: Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccusasamayam siṅgālassa vassamānassāti || ||

sn20.12:1.5: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
